definitions.explanation: The person who wrote a particular text, article, or book. Often used in formal or academic contexts to identify the writer of a specific work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The author of this article is unknown.

examples.japanese: {執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The author's name is listed at the end of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧{執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: This dictionary was completed through the cooperation of over a hundred contributors.

notes:
A formal term for the writer or author of a specific piece of writing. More specific than ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧ (novelist/writer as a profession) because it emphasizes the act of writing a particular work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of contributors
- {執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧: author introduction
- {執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: call for writers/contributors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧: author — emphasizes ownership of the work (used on book covers)
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer, novelist — refers to writing as a profession
- ⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧: writer — used within a text to refer to oneself (the present writer)

FORMS:
⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧ (writing, composing) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person)
